angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 355,503 km at 43.13 pc = 0.11 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 23.1878 +/- 0.0156 mas (same row, RUWE 1.35): 43.13 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.511 +/- 0.024 solar radii from Poultourtzidis et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1243 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...707A.106P/abstract): 355,503 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.515 +/- 0.027 solar masses from Poultourtzidis et al. 2026, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1243 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...707A.106P/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3515 +/- 79 K from Poultourtzidis et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1243 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...707A.106P/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Poultourtzidis et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1243 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...707A.106P/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-1243.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.733, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1243 (pscomppars): spectral type M2.0 V, from Poultourtzidis et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...707A.106P/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1243 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.2 dex, from Poultourtzidis et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...707A.106P/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1243 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -1.44551, from Poultourtzidis et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...707A.106P/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1243 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2 km/s, from Poultourtzidis et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...707A.106P/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
